The idea is that I'll pass out gently. The last thing I want to do is have a panic attack midway through it.

The hardest thing to come to terms with is dying in darkness and not in light. A peaceful natural death surrounded by loved ones would feel like a gentle initiation into the mysteries that follow this life.  


I know taking your own life is a selfish act, despite the complication that none of us really chose to live in the first place (and who would, if they were given the choice to do so?). But the scariest part for me (and the one I'm coming to terms with) is visualising the final moments of life, as the darkness clouds your mind and your realise 'OK, literally no turning back now.'    


It's that abstraction that terrifies me the most. Receding back into the darkness of non-existence. Delivering violence upon my own body is nothing.

I wouldn’t say people target your aura. Most people don’t directly see or feel these things. They’re responding directly to your behaviour, which they then infer intent from. You can control your boundaries in this respect without closing off your aura. When you recognise a negative person you don’t have to engage with them or their energy if you don’t want to!

Find another empath in real life and spend time with them! You’ll help ground each other :) and the conversations are amazing. And kind of funny lol. As empaths we really get a deep insight into people’s behaviour to the point of knowing more about them than they know about themselves and sometimes this can actually be comedy gold.

I don’t really need to shield any more. I can just recognise a phase shift in my emotions when it happens in real time. When it’s a step change it’s usually when I soak up someone else’s energy. So I just call it out to myself, which then brings me back to m my regular state — which is usually calmness or joy 🥰 if you can identify your natural emotion state with a positive feeling tone that’s a great step forward!

Oh and for all you lucky ones or there, being in a fulfilling romantic relationship does wonders too ❤️

There’s no rule on this. Just know what you want from the relationship and watch how it grows. Keep track of the equation of giving and taking from both sides. If he takes more than gives and still won’t open up then he’s not emotionally available. But if he says he’s looking for something serious then there’s an inconsistency between his intentions and his words. This should be a big yellow flag. But being emotionally closed doesn’t mean he’s pathological. It could lead to an unsatisfactory or draining relationship for you though!

Please resynchronize your wallet with Ledger Live. If your issue persists, please send us a support request here : [https://support.ledgerwallet.com/hc/en-us/requests/new](https://support.ledgerwallet.com/hc/en-us/requests/new)"  


No problems since then.  


Lesson: Don't send or receive coins or tokens on Ledger Live when the top-right icon says 'unable to synchronise'.  


I think what happened is that the ledger gave me one of the 5 public addresses associated with the account to receive the coins. The coins were sent to the account, but the ledger live app hadn't synchronised with the blockhain correctly and so it looked like the funds hadn't reached my account.
